g.text: UML Diagram: Class Agent in Context
- The arrows of the inheritance tree are

a.title: • CatalogDetails: A set of information useful for attribution, data discovery, and access.
a.xlink:title: • CatalogDetails: A set of information useful for attribution, data discovery, and access.

a.title: • Identifier: Identifier for objects requiring short- or long-lasting referencing and management.
a.xlink:title: • Identifier: Identifier for objects requiring short- or long-lasting referencing and management.

a.title: • PrivateImage: References an image using the standard Image description. In addition to the standard attributes provides an effective date (period) and a privacy ranking.
a.xlink:title: • PrivateImage: References an image using the standard Image description. In addition to the standard attributes provides an effective date (period) and a privacy ranking.

a.title: • InternationalString: Packaging structure for multilingual versions of the same string content, represented by a set of LanguageString. Only one LanguageString per language/scope type is allowed. Where an element of this type (InternationalString) is repeatable, the expectation is that each repetition contains a differen ...
a.xlink:title: • InternationalString: Packaging structure for multilingual versions of the same string content, represented by a set of LanguageString. Only one LanguageString per language/scope type is allowed. Where an element of this type (InternationalString) is repeatable, the expectation is that each repetition contains a differen ...

a.title: • AgentListing: Listing of agents of any type who may be organized to describe relationships between agents.
a.xlink:title: • AgentListing: Listing of agents of any type who may be organized to describe relationships between agents.

a.title: • AgentPosition: Assigns a sequence number to an agent in an agent listing.
a.xlink:title: • AgentPosition: Assigns a sequence number to an agent in an agent listing.

a.title: • AgentRelationship: Defines the relation of an agent within a structure.
a.xlink:title: • AgentRelationship: Defines the relation of an agent within a structure.

a.title: • CorrespondenceTable: Set of relationships between the members within or between statistical classifications.
a.xlink:title: • CorrespondenceTable: Set of relationships between the members within or between statistical classifications.

a.title: • ClassificationSeries: Ensemble of one or more statistical classifications, based on the same concept, and related to each other as versions or updates.
a.xlink:title: • ClassificationSeries: Ensemble of one or more statistical classifications, based on the same concept, and related to each other as versions or updates.

a.title: • ClassificationIndex: Ordered list of classification index entries.
a.xlink:title: • ClassificationIndex: Ordered list of classification index entries.

a.title: • AuthorizationSource: Identifies the authorizing agency and allows for the full text of the authorization (law, regulation, or other form of authorization).
a.xlink:title: • AuthorizationSource: Identifies the authorizing agency and allows for the full text of the authorization (law, regulation, or other form of authorization).

a.title: • Agent: Something that bears some form of responsibility for an activity taking place, for the existence of an entity, or for another agent's activity. (See the W3C PROV-O ontology, https://www.w3.org/TR/prov-dm/#term-agent)
a.xlink:title: • Agent: Something that bears some form of responsibility for an activity taking place, for the existence of an entity, or for another agent's activity. (See the W3C PROV-O ontology, https://www.w3.org/TR/prov-dm/#term-agent)

a.title: • IndividualMember: Distinct element that is not itself a collection (atomic).
a.xlink:title: • IndividualMember: Distinct element that is not itself a collection (atomic).

a.title: • Member: Element in a collection that can be either atomic (individual member) or composite (collection).
a.xlink:title: • Member: Element in a collection that can be either atomic (individual member) or composite (collection).

a.title: • Organization: Collection of people organized within a framework of authority that can perform an act or be associated with another agent.
a.xlink:title: • Organization: Collection of people organized within a framework of authority that can perform an act or be associated with another agent.

a.title: • Machine: Mechanism or computer program used to perform an act.
a.xlink:title: • Machine: Mechanism or computer program used to perform an act.

a.title: • Individual: A person. (See for example the W3C Friend of a Friend Ontology - http://xmlns.com/foaf/spec/#term_Person).
a.xlink:title: • Individual: A person. (See for example the W3C Friend of a Friend Ontology - http://xmlns.com/foaf/spec/#term_Person).

a.title: • ProcessingAgent: A processing agent orchestrates the production of information objects in a production environment. There are processing agents which perform data capture, data editing/processing, and data analysis (etc.), each in the appropriate production environments. The processing agent performs an activity bas ...
a.xlink:title: • ProcessingAgent: A processing agent orchestrates the production of information objects in a production environment. There are processing agents which perform data capture, data editing/processing, and data analysis (etc.), each in the appropriate production environments. The processing agent performs an activity bas ...

a.title: • Curator: Curator is a software agent that uses techniques such as natural language processing to map facts in the research data store to the condition part of a rule.
a.xlink:title: • Curator: Curator is a software agent that uses techniques such as natural language processing to map facts in the research data store to the condition part of a rule.

a.title: • Service: Service is a type of processing agent. Services are atomic. They execute acts which have input and output parameters.
a.xlink:title: • Service: Service is a type of processing agent. Services are atomic. They execute acts which have input and output parameters.

a.xlink:title: • isMaintainedBy: The unit or group of persons within the organization responsible for the agent listing (i.e., for adding, changing or deleting agent entries).

a.title: • hasSource: The subject in the description of a paired relationship - for example the Parent agent in the hierarchical Parent of Child relationship.
a.xlink:title: • hasSource: The subject in the description of a paired relationship - for example the Parent agent in the hierarchical Parent of Child relationship.

a.title: • hasTarget: The object in the description of a paired relationship - for example the Object agent in the hierarchical Parent of Child relationship.
a.xlink:title: • hasTarget: The object in the description of a paired relationship - for example the Object agent in the hierarchical Parent of Child relationship.

a.title: • hasContact: Person(s) who may be contacted for additional information about the classification index.
a.xlink:title: • hasContact: Person(s) who may be contacted for additional information about the classification index.

a.title: • isMaintainedBy: The unit or group of persons within the organization responsible for the classification index (i.e., for adding, changing or deleting classification index entries).
a.xlink:title: • isMaintainedBy: The unit or group of persons within the organization responsible for the classification index (i.e., for adding, changing or deleting classification index entries).

a.title: • isOwnedBy: The statistical office or other authority, which created and maintains the statistical classification(s) related to the classification series. A classification series may have several owners.
a.xlink:title: • isOwnedBy: The statistical office or other authority, which created and maintains the statistical classification(s) related to the classification series. A classification series may have several owners.

a.title: • hasContact: The person(s) who may be contacted for additional information about the correspondence table. Can be an individual or organization.
a.xlink:title: • hasContact: The person(s) who may be contacted for additional information about the correspondence table. Can be an individual or organization.

a.title: • isMaintainedBy: The unit or group of persons who are responsible for the correspondence table (i.e., for maintaining and updating it).
a.xlink:title: • isMaintainedBy: The unit or group of persons who are responsible for the correspondence table (i.e., for maintaining and updating it).

a.title: • isOwnedBy: The statistical office, other authority or section that created and maintains the correspondence table. A correspondence table may have several owners.
